changeSet.author: hephaestus-evidence-contract
changeSet.comment: Create a new current revision for the automated-assessment policy while preserving historical meaning.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO practice_revision ( practice_id, revision_number, criteria, created_at, slug, name, applies_to, trigger_events, precompute_script, why_it_matters, what_good_looks_like, area_slug, area_name, area_description, area_icon, area_color, detection_fingerprint, automated_assessment_policy ) SELECT practice.id, COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(existing.revision_number) + 1 FROM practice_revision existing WHERE existing.practice_id = practice.id ), 1), practice.criteria, now(), practice.slug, practice.name, practice.applies_to, practice.trigger_events, practice.precompute_script, practice.why_it_matters, practice.what_good_looks_like, area.slug, area.name, area.description, area.icon, area.color, NULL, practice.automated_assessment_policy FROM practice LEFT JOIN practice_area area ON area.id = practice.practice_area_id;
UPDATE practice SET current_revision_id = revision.id FROM practice_revision revision WHERE revision.practice_id = practice.id AND revision.automated_assessment_policy IS NOT NULL AND revision.revision_number = ( SELECT MAX(candidate.revision_number) FROM practice_revision candidate WHERE candidate.practice_id = practice.id AND candidate.automated_assessment_policy IS NOT NULL );

rollback.sql:
UPDATE practice SET current_revision_id = previous.id, slug = previous.slug, name = previous.name, applies_to = previous.applies_to, trigger_events = previous.trigger_events, criteria = previous.criteria, precompute_script = previous.precompute_script, why_it_matters = previous.why_it_matters, what_good_looks_like = previous.what_good_looks_like, practice_area_id = ( SELECT area.id FROM practice_area area WHERE area.workspace_id = practice.workspace_id AND area.slug = previous.area_slug ) FROM practice_revision boundary JOIN practice_revision previous ON previous.practice_id = boundary.practice_id AND previous.revision_number = boundary.revision_number - 1 WHERE boundary.practice_id = practice.id AND boundary.automated_assessment_policy IS NOT NULL AND previous.automated_assessment_policy IS NULL AND boundary.revision_number = ( SELECT MIN(candidate.revision_number) FROM practice_revision candidate JOIN practice_revision before_candidate ON before_candidate.practice_id = candidate.practice_id AND before_candidate.revision_number = candidate.revision_number - 1 WHERE candidate.practice_id = practice.id AND candidate.automated_assessment_policy IS NOT NULL AND before_candidate.automated_assessment_policy IS NULL );
DELETE FROM practice_revision WHERE automated_assessment_policy IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_practice_revision_immutability() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $immutable_revision$ BEGIN IF NEW.practice_id = OLD.practice_id AND NEW.revision_number = OLD.revision_number AND NEW.created_at = OLD.created_at AND NEW.slug IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.slug AND NEW.name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.name AND NEW.applies_to IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.applies_to AND NEW.trigger_events IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.trigger_events AND NEW.criteria = OLD.criteria AND NEW.precompute_script IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.precompute_script AND NEW.automated_assessment_policy IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.automated_assessment_policy AND NEW.why_it_matters IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.why_it_matters AND NEW.what_good_looks_like IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.what_good_looks_like AND NEW.area_slug IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.area_slug AND NEW.area_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.area_name AND NEW.area_description IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.area_description AND NEW.area_icon IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.area_icon AND NEW.area_color IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.area_color AND ( NEW.review_rule_fingerprint IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.review_rule_fingerprint OR OLD.review_rule_fingerprint IS NULL ) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; RAISE EXCEPTION 'practice revisions are immutable' USING ERRCODE = '55000'; END; $immutable_revision$;
